sepulcher_commander: Commander Halvard Vane. This is the Keep Hall, and the Sepulcher under it holds the west of Silverpine for the Dark Lady. The dead have taken to it better than the living ever did. I have a forest full of things that used to be my neighbours and a garrison that fits in one court. If you can follow an order, I have orders.
sepulcher_adjutant: Adjutant Kess. I keep the Commander's rolls, here in the Keep Hall, and I can tell you the strength of this garrison to the man, which is a short conversation. The Commander speaks to you or he does not. Either way, stand up straight. Not that it matters.
sepulcher_mourner: They call me the Mourner. This is the Raven Hill Terrace, the west side of the keep, where the old stones are. I do not remember who I am mourning. I only know I have not stopped. The farmhands up at the Farthing wore wreaths, at the end. I would like those back.
sepulcher_relic_hunter: Darne, relic hunter. I work the middle of the keep, between the Hall and the Lower Court, because that is where the crypt doors are. These crypts are older than the Scourge and older than Lordaeron. Whatever is buried down there, it is not ours to wake - but the pieces that have already come up, I will pay for.
sepulcher_gravestone_reader: Reader Cass. I read the stones on the Raven Hill Terrace, and you are standing on it. Half of them are worn smooth. I read them anyway, because a name nobody says is a name that is finished, and the rain here is in a hurry.
sepulcher_tomb_keeper: Ellowyn, tomb-keeper. The east tombs are mine, away from the court where it is quiet. Every one of them held someone's name once. I try to remember them, since no one else will. Lately some of the ones I remember have been seen walking on Raven Hill, north of our gate.
sepulcher_bone_carver: Yseult. I carve bone, in the middle of the keep where the light is least bad. I carve what the tombs give up. Some of it is art. Most of it is a warning, and the Commander hangs those on the gate. I am short of good marrow-bone, if you are going out.
pt_sepulcher_hide: Mortimer, tanner. My frames are on the west side, above the Lower Court. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - all of it crosses my bench, and I teach all of it for one fee. I do not eat any more. I still will not see it wasted.
pt_sepulcher_forge: Ysolde. I teach mining and smithing, ore in one hand and hammer in the other. I will tell you now that the Sepulcher has no forge of its own - this is a tomb with a garrison in it. Learn here, then carry your ore to Brill or the Undercity to work it.
pt_sepulcher_wood: Edda, woodwright. I teach felling and shaping in the middle of the keep. The Sepulcher has no sawmill, so you learn the cuts from me and make them elsewhere - there is a mill at Valgan's Field, in the south of the forest. Silverpine is still good timber. It is the only thing here that is.
sepulcher_lost_soul: ... the Lower Court. I know that much. I stand in the Lower Court. There was a name. It went somewhere without me. If you find a thing out there that looks as though it was held a great deal - bring it. I might know it.
pt_sepulcher_essence: Thessaly. They call me Tinker, and I answer to it. I teach engineering and the cutting of crystal at the top of the Lower Court. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Mine are steadier than they were when I had a pulse.
ct_sepulcher: Corvin. I train every discipline, on the west side of the Lower Court. I have taught each of them at one time or another and I am not precious about which you picked. Half this garrison learned from me twice - once before, once after. Show me where you are, and bring coin.
sepulcher_flight_master: Odo, bat handler. The roost is here in the Lower Court, just inside the gate. Fly the route north and you will be over the Rear Guard and into Tirisfal without ever touching the Trunk Road, which I recommend. Where to?
sepulcher_hermit: Go away. Or stay, I suppose. This is the south-east corner of the keep and I chose it because nobody comes here. It has been quiet a long time. My lamp is low, and the oil I burn comes out of spiders, and I am not going to fetch it myself.
sepulcher_pilgrim: Osk. A pilgrim, if you want a word for it. I rest here by the south gate of the Sepulcher between walks. I go from tomb to tomb through these woods and I could not tell you why. Perhaps I am looking for my own. The road is worse than it was.
pt_sepulcher_herbs: Grimsby, apothecary. I teach herbs and what to do with them, in the south-west corner of the Lower Court. Every weed is a medicine to someone, and in Silverpine most of them are a poison to someone else. I will show you which to pull. The second part is where people go wrong.
sepulcher_crypt_guard: Molsen, crypt guard. This is the south gate, the only one, and the stair to the lower vaults is behind me. Nothing gets in or out of those vaults while I stand here. The crows from the Dead Field have started sitting on the gate and watching me do it.
